war_summary: On Day 107 of War 139, heavy combat is raging across both active island sectors and pivotal mainland frontlines. Island and coastal theaters remain highly volatile, with Oarbreaker and Godcrofts recording continuous base captures and neutralizations alongside intense clashes in Endless Shore. Concurrently, intense combat and accelerating casualty rates dominate key mainland transit corridors and contested borderlands, particularly across Olavis Wake, Marban Hollow, and Callahan's Passage.
